offers.t: Mobile Application Developer - AI Neobank App
offers.sn: About KIRA Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone. In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region.
offers.rq: We are looking for Android engineers to build the native Android experience for KIRA's AI Neobank App. 3+ years of Android development experience using Kotlin. Language English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
